workflow: TRELLIS.2 image-to-3D; these PNGs are not 3D assets
coverage: All 16 surface facility kinds from js/rendering/colony-surface-plan.js

assets.brief: Single outdoor farm plot with crop beds, barn, irrigation and utility pad.
Single freestanding glass greenhouse with visible growing racks, service block and pipework.
Single manufacturing hall with loading doors, exterior pipes, utility module and exhaust stack.
Single foundation-mounted solar array with inverter, support frames and cable conduits.
Three upright liquid storage tanks with access ladders, safety rails, pumps and manifold.
Two dry-bulk silos with conical hoppers, support legs, conveyor and loading bay.
Central compact reactor with paired cooling assemblies, conduits and control building.
Low U-shaped research laboratory with glazed wings and rooftop instrument dome.
Single open-frame drilling derrick with machinery, service cabin and work platform.
Single broad logistics hall with three loading bays, canopy and attached office; no smokestack.
Sealed cleanroom fabrication hall with blue observation windows and attached filtration module.
Low-rise clinic with medical wings, simple rooftop landing marker and red beacon.
Low-rise classroom wings around a planted central courtyard.
Central two-storey operations block with flanking wings, communications mast and sensors.
Civilian guardhouse within a fenced site with controlled barrier gate and light mast.
Atmosphere-processing core with staged intake tower, scrubbers, conduits and control cabin.

limitations: References are generic, not faction-specific or scale-calibrated.
No TRELLIS.2 inference or GLB export has been run for these images.
Open-pit mining remains procedural terrain, not a drilling-facility model.
